text: Worst trade ever, or did he know something we do not?
Ronald Wayne drafted Apple's first partnership agreement.
12 days after signing it, he removed his name.
Apple was not a corporation yet.
If it could not pay, every partner could be personally liable.
Jobs and Wozniak were young and broke.
Wayne was 41 with a house, a car, and money creditors could reach.
The twist? Wayne believed in Apple.
Done. It was the right product at the right times.
He left because he expected decades of paperwork instead of building his own inventions.
Lock your verdict, sell or stay.
Wayne says he does not regret leaving Apple.
He sold the original contract for $500.
So was he history's biggest fool or did $800 buy his freedom?
